Made by Massimo Nastasi. Free, no adverts, no network access, no data collected, and no permissions requested.

The artwork is Freedoom, by the Freedoom project. The movement, timings and creature values are taken from the engine source release by id Software, which is why this app is GPL-2.0 and its source is public. Neither project endorses or is involved in this one.

Thanks to everyone who kept both of those alive long enough to build on.

The scene always thinks at the original 35 steps a second. The frame rate is only how often it is drawn, and it is the one setting here that changes battery use.
